A '''stasis tube''' was a large tank where a living organic being was placed to be kept in suspended animation.

==History==
On [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], the [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|''Alpha''-class Advanced Recon Commandos]] were kept in stasis tubes after being trained by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and prime clone [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. The [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] were afraid of their unpredictability and thus kept them in stasis. The ARC's were only revived as a last resort when [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] was in danger of being overrun by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droids]].<ref name="R50" />

[[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88B]] maintained a single stasis tube aboard the [[IG-2000/Legends|IG-2000]]. The tube was used by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] to keep critically injured captives alive during transport.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
